notes: Portable C++ and Java parity for the mapped native 27-assertion HLA_EVOKED restore-resignation case. Two federates complete an untimed save. A restore request queues callbacks; before either member evokes them, one resigns. The surviving member receives its queued restore-request, restore-begun, and initiation callbacks followed by Federation Not Restored with FEDERATE_RESIGNED_DURING_RESTORE. The departed member receives no queued public restore callback when evoked after resignation. The adapter supplies provider, standard FOM, endpoint, and callback model. The native case and portable C++ primary/contract passed against the installed package; Java compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime witness. Two direct requirement-section mappings cover Clause 4.33. This is bounded public-API evidence, not a durable restore, cross-provider interoperability, immediate-callback, or conformance claim.
